story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: It began on a rainy afternoon in Kochi, over spilled coffee and an argument about which was the better filter — the one from a family gathering neither of us wanted to attend, but are now endlessly grateful for.
What followed were years of long phone calls, longer road trips, and the quiet realisation that home was no longer a place — it was a person.
Now, surrounded by the families who raised us and the friends who've walked beside us, we're ready to begin the next chapter — as one.

storyTimeline.title: How We Met
storyTimeline.description: A mutual friend's engagement party, one shared umbrella, and a conversation that lasted until the venue lights came on.

storyTimeline.title: The Proposal
storyTimeline.description: On a quiet evening by the backwaters, with the whole family waiting just around the corner to celebrate with us.

storyTimeline.title: Our Wedding
storyTimeline.description: The day we've been waiting for — and we couldn't be more grateful to share it with the people we love most.

events.name: Wedding Ceremony

events.name: Reception
